description.en: Generic pedagogical loose oncoid bed, not reconstruction of a measured Hydra bed or a single source locality. UGS primary slab/core pixels support cm-scale shapes and coating/nucleus relationships; Hydra text supports irregular overlapping lamination but its1.8–4.1mm grain dimensions are not imported. Art arrangement,count,color,size and enlarged legibility are explicit; no assertion of a specific organism or unique growth process.
